purpose: Record the verb spellings used by the RELATIONAL book against the canonical relation vocabulary, without promoting any of them to VerifiedRelation.

law.promoter_note: VerifiedRelation requires an exact case-sensitive match against the C++ relation ISA. That header is not present in this tree, so nothing here can be promoted locally.
law.candidate: A verb not in the canonical enum parses through the grammar's string catch-all and becomes a RelationCandidate with confidence < 1.0. It must pass Ch'en before use in B.
law.no_silent_promotion: data/grammar/gml.validator.json relation_authority: a near-miss verb is a RelationCandidate with reduced confidence, not a VerifiedRelation with a typo
law.consequence: Editing relation_verb to list these spellings would BE the silent promotion the law forbids. The enum is left untouched.

trace.law: a recorded RELATION dispatch never promotes an alias spelling to a VerifiedRelation; the trace preserves the spelling and the candidate status it had

fields.xcfe: the dispatched operator name, preserved verbatim

realization.rule: an alias spelling may be realized as prose by a declarative template, because rendering an edge is not verifying it
realization.requirement: every template for a non-canonical spelling must declare the spelling in via_alias, so the frame never implies VerifiedRelation
forbidden: claiming VerifiedRelation for an alias spelling
